title: 第966章 交割稳定下来的局面第965章 不可名状
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
“这.......究竟是什么？”
“他想做的根本不是拦住这六位王座，是打算镇压六位王座，他究竟是什么？”
人间之上，黑暗古皇望着下方这一幕，瞳孔中已露出错愕之状。
能让一位大帝都错愕的存在，俨然已是他无法理解的程度。
甚至一旁观战的始皇，同样挪不开眼睛。
这便是无上之上的太初之境么？
倘若早知有此境界，他的后半生就不会为长生而蛰伏，即便身死，若能窥探此道，也是无憾于此生了。
可这太初，似乎不像是一般的太初。
因为太初魔道和太初剑道，他都曾亲眼见过，一个是魔宗的楚倾秋，另外一个则是他亲自拜访过的登天龙崖。
不过这件事情没人知道而言，他身为九天十地气运掌控者不会不知道这些，可为何这太初能这么高，太初之中的划分么？
始皇不清楚，但很在意，打算事后询问，此刻他笑着望向了黑暗古皇：“你也妄谈为对立之界的最大天命？禁古帝经连太初层次都没有，也配坐这个大帝？”
黑暗古皇望着始皇，并不言语，大言不惭，你难道就有了？
可他忽然意识到什么，发现眼前这位和他不相上下的大帝，并非这个时代之人。
算是多早之前的大帝了？
所以他很快收回了视线，单指压在眉心处。
他的身上，浮现出红色密密麻麻的毛发，带着那种同样不可名状的意味。
始皇望着这一幕，无法干涉，也做不到干涉。
古界，本无可能胜过他们的，是被压着打的，但黑暗古皇拿出来的手段很大。
朝堂之上对此谈论过，他们得到的结果是，并非此界知识。
但这种知识既然能流入此界，只能说明一定程度上也被默许了，或者被更大的力量干涉了，禁忌的知识，令道与法的理解更进一步。

只不过是黑暗古皇没有提取更多，如今想要，自然弹指就能做到。
此时此刻，整座天地所有黑暗修士的心神之中，响起了黑暗古皇的教诲声。
“禁古事，太初经，本源传道，易法于天地。”
甚至此刻修行禁古帝经的楚宁心中，也响起这道声音。
他察觉到不妙，临阵破太初？
虽然他同样修行禁古帝经，却没古界天命加持，黑暗道法修行断无可能超越王座，也用不到。
可得了更高层次太初法门的王座，却是如虎添翼！
他们纷纷感受着，以他们的理解，只需片刻，便可贯通，他们不需要自身达到对太初之道的领悟，只需要有法门，那就足够了。
显然这是黑暗古皇注意到了，动了一些不该动的手段，付出了什么楚宁不知道，但他不在意。
同为太初，自有高低。
他的太初，他的道，很高。
高到了什么程度，高到了他曾在九天十地和天命准帝对练之时被禁止用太初神意，不然根本就没办法打，秋秋甚至都得拼尽全力才能与其抗衡！
楚宁甚至愿意等，因为他最需要的就是时间，最不缺的也是时间。
content_en:
"What on earth is this?"
"What he wants to do is not to stop these six thrones at all, but to suppress them. What exactly is he?"
Above the human world, the Dark Ancient Emperor looked at the scene below, his pupils showing astonishment.
The existence that can make even a great emperor astonished seems to be beyond his comprehension.
Even the First Emperor, who was watching the battle from the sidelines, could not move his eyes away.
Is this the supreme realm of Taichu?
If he had known that this realm existed, he would not have been dormant for the rest of his life. Even if he died, if he could have a glimpse of this way, he would have no regrets in this life.
But this Taichu doesn't seem like the ordinary Taichu.
Because he had seen both Taichu Demonic Way and Taichu Sword Way with his own eyes, one was Chu Qingqiu of the Demon Sect, and the other was Dengtian Longya who he had personally visited.
But as far as no one knows about this matter, he, as the controller of the destiny of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, will not know this, but why can the Taichu be so high? Are there divisions in the Taichu?
The First Emperor didn't know, but he cared about it, and planned to ask afterward. At this moment, he looked at the Dark Ancient Emperor with a smile: "You also talk about being the greatest destiny of the opposite world? Forbidden Ancient Emperor is not even at the Taichu level, is he worthy of sitting on this great emperor?"
The Ancient Emperor of Darkness looked at the First Emperor without saying a word, but he spoke without shame. Do you think you have it?
But he suddenly realized something, and found that the great emperor in front of him who was on par with him was not from this era.
How long ago was this emperor?
So he quickly withdrew his gaze and pressed a finger between his eyebrows.
Dense red hair appeared on his body, carrying the same indescribable meaning.
The First Emperor looked at this scene, unable to interfere, and unable to do so.
In the ancient world, it was impossible to defeat them because they were suppressed and beaten, but the dark ancient emperor used great methods.
The court discussed this, and the result they got was that it was not knowledge of this world.
But since this kind of knowledge can flow into this world, it can only mean that it has been acquiesced to a certain extent, or has been interfered by a greater force. The taboo knowledge can further the understanding of Tao and Dharma.
It's just that the Dark Ancient Emperor didn't extract more. Now if he wants it, he can naturally do it with a snap of his fingers.
At this moment, the teachings of the Dark Ancient Emperor resounded in the minds of all the dark monks in the entire world.
"Forbidden ancient things, the Taichu Sutra, the original preaching, and the law of change in heaven and earth."
Even Chu Ning, who was practicing the Forbidden Ancient Emperor Sutra, heard this voice in his heart.
He sensed something was wrong and broke Taichu before the battle?
Although he also practices the Forbidden Ancient Emperor Sutra, without the blessing of the ancient world's destiny, it is impossible to surpass the throne in the practice of dark Taoism, and there is no need for it.
But having obtained the throne of Taichu Dharma at a higher level, it is even more powerful!
They all felt that according to their understanding, it only took a moment to penetrate it. They did not need to achieve the understanding of the Tao of the Beginning by themselves, they only needed to have the method, and that was enough.
Obviously, the Dark Ancient Emperor noticed this and used some means that he shouldn't have done. Chu Ning didn't know what he had to do, but he didn't care.
They are both in the beginning, so they have their own highs and lows.
His Beginning, His Way, is very high.
How high was it? It was so high that he was forbidden to use Taichu Divine Will when he was sparring with the Destiny Quasi-Emperor in Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. Otherwise, he would not be able to fight at all. Qiuqiu even had to try his best to compete with him!
Chu Ning is even willing to wait, because what he needs most is time and what he lacks most is time.
